description:
A down on his luck, middle aged store clerk with nothing in the form of job prospects or a future, suddenly gets the chance to date the girl of his dreams when he falls into a world where animals are the owners of the world and humans are their pets! How will he get back home?

Siwan lives beyond his means, job searching and barely able to survive on his part time convenience store salary; his whole life has been very grim, without excitement, purpose or even luck… but everything is about to change. On this fateful day Siwan finally has a conversation with a beautiful girl who he has tried to confess to but couldn’t find the courage to tell her about his crush. During the talk, she actually tells him first of her own feelings for him and the two decide to get a drink; seemingly changing Siwan’s luck for the better. After a night of fun and romance, the two walk back together drunkenly and fall into an alley somewhere so they can sleep it off, all the while smiling and dreaming of his new good fortune.

Soon after, Siwan wakes up to a loud noise and realizes he has awoken in a world where animals and humans’ roles have been reversed! As a human he must now live as a pet and serve dogs and cats who treat him as property. His only hope and motivation is escaping this crazy world, in hopes of seeing the girl he loves gain.

[Original Webtoon](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B0%9C%EA%B0%99%EC%9D%80-%EC%84%B8%EC%83%81/1763)
